vision.name: Saiyan Clench
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 3.
(Limit 2 per deck. Villains only. This card cannot be attached unless the highest power level on your MP's Level 4 is 500,000 or less.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Attach to your MP. While attached, your attacks that do not have AT base damage have their power stage damage doubled.
Damage: 3 stages.
